meta.title: ag04 - les'ters
meta.author: Agoston
meta.description: ag04 - les'ters by Agoston, a Farbrausch V2 song (.v2m format version 6) taken from modland's V2 collection (`pub/modules/V2/Agoston/ag04 - les'ters.v2m`). 120 BPM, 2:11, 10 tracks. The V2 file's last tick is at 202:57; the song here ends 4 s after the last note (a note held more than 16 s past the last note-on is cut there). This is an adapted version, not the original recording: converted by `synth-convert v2m` to the unified synth (instrument kind 64) and imported with `song import`. This song was not parity-checked on its own; the V2 import passes on the 18 songs that were (within 0.9 dB loudness and 1.8 dB per octave band of the v2redux reference). Agoston is the joint alias of Teo and Vincenzo; they gave permission (2026-11-09) to publish Agoston's music here as adapted versions; the music belongs to them and is removed at their request.
